rules.name: Four or more authorisations on one card within an hour
Amount more than five times this card’s average
First authorisation from a device this card has not used
Card issued in a different country to the merchant
Authorisation between one and five in the morning
Merchant category with elevated historical loss

context.analystHour: One analyst has an hour before the card network cut-off, which is about fifty alerts.
context.note: The queue as stored is the rules engine’s own ordering, highest rule score first. The score itself is not shown to the model.
